people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
translations.bsb: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. Let them measure the plan,
translations.kjv: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
translations.asv: Thou, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
